user.title: Add the ZBT-2 LED
user.description:
Zigbee Home Automation is using the Home Assistant Connect ZBT-2 with serial number {serial_number}. Add its LED as a light?

This controls the LED through Zigbee Home Automation's own connection to the adapter, which relies on parts of Home Assistant that are not a public interface. An update can stop it working until this integration is updated; it then shows as unavailable with a repair, and Zigbee keeps working.

error.zha_not_loaded: Zigbee Home Automation is not running. Start it, wait until it is loaded, then try again.
error.led_not_supported: The ZBT-2's Zigbee firmware does not offer LED control. Update the adapter firmware, restart Zigbee Home Automation, then try again.
error.incompatible: This version of Home Assistant or its Zigbee library is not one this integration supports. Check for an update to this integration.

abort.zha_not_set_up: Set up Zigbee Home Automation on the ZBT-2 first.
abort.no_zbt2: Zigbee Home Automation is not using a Home Assistant Connect ZBT-2.
abort.already_configured: This ZBT-2's LED is already added.

data_description.max_brightness: Caps how bright the LED gets, whatever brightness the light is set to. The light still reports the brightness it was set to.

data_description.idle_behavior: What the LED shows after Home Assistant or Zigbee Home Automation restarts while the light is off.

options.hands_off: Leave it alone, so the adapter's own status light works until the light is next used

incompatible_zha.title: ZBT-2 LED cannot reach the adapter
incompatible_zha.description:
The ZBT-2 LED light is unavailable because Home Assistant's Zigbee internals are not shaped the way this integration expects: {error}

Zigbee keeps working. Check for an update to this integration; it relies on parts of Home Assistant that can change in any release.

led_not_supported.title: ZBT-2 firmware has no LED control
led_not_supported.description:
The ZBT-2 LED light is unavailable because the adapter's Zigbee firmware does not offer LED control ({error}).

Update the ZBT-2 firmware, then restart Zigbee Home Automation.

led_command_failed.title: ZBT-2 LED is not responding
led_command_failed.description:
The adapter has rejected several LED commands in a row: {error}

The integration keeps retrying and clears this repair once a command gets through. If it persists, restart Zigbee Home Automation.

unknown_effect.message: The ZBT-2 LED has no effect named {effect}.

zha_not_set_up.message: Zigbee Home Automation is not set up for this ZBT-2.
